sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 10165616 (search/campsites API, read 2026-10-28)

values.note: $22 a site (2025-2028 first-come seasons on recreation.gov). Two vehicles or one RV included; $11 for a third vehicle; $11 day use.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/selkirk-campground ('$22 fee per site for overnight camping. Two vehicles or one RV per site is included in the camping fee. $11 fee for a third vehicle.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165616/rates (First-come, First-served Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-10-11: WalkInScanPay1 22; same for 2027), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Two vehicles or one RV per site; max 8 people and 2 tents.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/selkirk-campground ('It has 15 campsites with a maximum trailer length of 25 feet'; 'The max length for RVs/trailers is 25 feet'; 'A maximum of eight people, two tents and two vehicles or one recreational vehicle (RV) is allowed per site'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: No trash service: pack it in, pack it out. Facility roads are not paved.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/selkirk-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.'; 'No trash services are available.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165616 (notices: 'This is a "Pack It In - Pack It Out Facility!'; 'Facility roads are not paved.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Mid-May to mid-October, weather dependent (FS); recreation.gov: 'Camping season begins in May and continues until the road is snowed in.'

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/selkirk-campground ('This campground is open mid-May to mid-October, weather dependent.'; 'Seasons of Use: Mid-May to mid-October') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165616 (notice), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Strictly first come, first served; pay at the self-service fee tube (cash, check or money order) or by recreation.gov Scan & Pay. A first-come site must be occupied the same night. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/selkirk-campground ('This campground is strictly first come, first served.'; 'No more than a 14-night consecutive stay is permitted in the campground.'; 'A self-service fee tube is available for on-site payment. First-come, first-served sites must be occupied the same night.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165616 ('This location is available on a first-come, first-served basis only'; Scan and Pay), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 50% off the site the pass holder occupies (concessionaire-run).

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/selkirk-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites. The discount only applies to the fee for the campsite physically occupied by the pass owner'), read 2026-10-28

note: Pike NF (South Park RD) campground at 10,500 ft, 8 mi north of Como: from US 285 at Como take County Road 33 to County Road 50, then Forest Road 33 about 4 mi and Road 33.3A 3/4 mi to the campground. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov: confirmed $22, 15 sites, vault toilets, no water, FCFS only. Added max RV/trailer 25 ft (FS), 14-night limit, season note (mid-May to mid-October), senior-pass discount, fees checked 2026. Note rewritten: field facts dropped, and the unsourced 'Boreas Pass Rd (narrow/bumpy 2WD)' replaced by the FS directions.
flags: Website: stored https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc is the forest home page; the campground's own FS page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/selkirk-campground (recreation.gov FCFS listing: https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/10165616).

Phone missing: South Park Ranger District 719-836-2031 (FS campground page contact; Fairplay). recreation.gov gives the concessionaire's line instead: 'For facility specific information, please call (661) 702-1420' (email at goexplorus.com).
Operator: concessionaire (Explorus, per recreation.gov's contact email; the FS page calls it 'concessionaire-run') on Pike NF land; ownership left federal.

Road: no agency page found that rates the access road. The FS directions are CR 33 to CR 50, Forest Road 33 about 4 mi, then Road 33.3A 3/4 mi; recreation.gov: 'Facility roads are not paved.' The old note's 'Boreas Pass Rd (narrow/bumpy 2WD)' had no agency source and was dropped. No 4WD or high-clearance wording on either page.

Closures: none found for the campground or its roads. PSICC alerts (read 2026-10-28) list the Willow Fire Area Closure (Leadville RD, Turquoise Lake/Halfmoon area) and an NFSR 8 construction closure on the South Park RD; neither names CR 33/50, FR 33 or Selkirk. Past its season now.

Pin 39.37224,-105.95148 is the FS/recreation.gov facility point (the catalog has a single placeholder site there). On Esri imagery it sits on the campground's loop road in the trees above a creek meadow (~150 m SW), so it is on the campground. Not waterfront: the meadow and its small creek are not beside the sites; stored value fine.
